text:
elaine: Hey team — my docs PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321) is blocked by CI. Preview failed: md-lint (line-length + list-indent), vale flagged a style rule, and linkcheck reports a broken anchor. Need a quick triage; hoping to get it merged in tomorrow's pre-release window.

james: I can take the anchor/linkcheck part. Which page?

elaine: /guides/private-deploy.md -> anchor `kms-integration` seems renamed to `kms-setup` in a recent refactor. Preview logs: 
```
LinkCheckError: /guides/private-deploy.md: anchor not found: kms-integration
  in /guides/private-deploy.md: line 312
```

katie: I can handle short lint fixes (wrap long lines, fix list indentation). If we keep changes tiny we can squash before merge. :thumbsup:

ben: vale flagged 'avoid excited punctuation' in the intro where we have "great!" — we should change to "recommended." I'll PR a one-line fix unless you want it in the same commit, elaine.

elaine: Prefer one PR — less churn. james: can you push anchor rename in a tiny patch to the same branch or should I?

james: I can open a branch and push a commit to your branch if you grant push perms, or you can apply the change. Which do you prefer?

elaine: I'll allow edits from maintainers on the PR and you can push. Plan: james = anchor fix, katie = md-lint, ben = vale tweak. I'll run preview again after.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #563 failed — md-lint errors: MD013 (line length) in /guides/private-deploy.md:312, MD004 (unordered list style) in /reference/console.md:45. Linkcheck failed: 1 broken anchor. Vale: Cliche -> AvoidCliche at /getting-started/intro.md:12.

katie: Quick question — do we want to auto-wrap long example YAML blocks or leave them and shorten surrounding prose? Wrapping YAML can break rendering.

elaine: Don't wrap fenced code blocks. Fix prose lines only. If a long code example exceeds MD013, we can add an md-lint override comment near the block.

ben: I'll update intro wording to remove "great!" -> "recommended" and add a Vale suppress for the line if needed.

james: pushed anchor fix to elaine's branch: commit 7a9f2c. Link now points to #kms-setup.

docs-bot: New commit detected on PR 4321 by james. Re-running docs preview...

ci-bot: docs-preview build #564 queued.

elaine: Thanks. katie, ben — any ETA for your small fixes?

katie: I'll open a tiny commit in ~20m for MD013 + MD004 fixes. Will include comment explaining not to change code blocks.

ben: 10m for wording + Vale suppress if still flagged.

elaine: If CI passes after these three commits, can someone approve? I'm away for release handover at 16:00 PT. Prefer merge by 15:45 so release engineers can pick changes.

james: I can approve once green.

katie: same.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #564 succeeded.

elaine: Awesome — thanks all. Can one of you squash the three tiny fix commits into a single commit and merge with fast-forward? We prefer a single-author commit for changelog clarity.

james: I'll squash locally and push a force-update to the branch, then merge via the GitHub UI.

docs-bot: PR 4321 merged by james at 1745007123.

elaine: Love it — release window safe. Will follow up if any post-merge rendering issues crop up. :rocket:
